mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, username, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, username, password_hash as passwordHash, role, status, last_login_at as lastLoginAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, username, password_hash as passwordHash, role, status, last_login_at as lastLoginAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, username, password_hash as passwordHash, role, status, last_login_at as lastLoginAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
